_help: MotionLab's roadmap - the one file to edit. docs/roadmap/index.html draws it as a motion graphic (the app's Home plays it
live); tools/roadmap.py render makes docs/roadmap.png (README) and, with --video, docs/roadmap.mp4 from it.
versions: one line each, any order (sorted by number). Majors = x.y.0: a big badge with an icon on the main line;
every other number (0.4.2, 0.4.1.1, 0.6.5) hangs below the major of its x.y. Keys: v, label (<= 24 characters),
icon + line (majors: one sentence <= 110 characters), items (optional chips, <= 5 x <= 22 characters), title (the
heading in plans.md / CHANGELOG.md - written by sync, shown on hover), status (optional: done | next | planned |
later - normally derived: up to 'here' done, the first after it next, then planned up to the next major, later after).
icons: analyze prepare edit generate memory library knowledge home videos prompts claude update news settings.
phases: [{label, line, from, to}] = spans of versions drawn as brackets above the main line (from / to = versions;
the one 'here' falls in is lit). Inside the app the page's words follow the app's language: the Spanish of every
label / line / item / title / phase = "<English>|roadmap" in tools/motionlab/app/ui/i18n/parts/es.release.json,
each key also in its _by_key (a new label gets its Spanish there in the same change).
After a change: .venv\Scripts\python tools\roadmap.py check (agrees with plans.md + CHANGELOG.md?), then render.
